subject: The 2-minute date that saved Tuesday night
preview_text: How one couple turned 20 minutes of planning into 2 seconds of tapping
body_paragraphs: Tuesday night. You promised a date. Then the planning fatigue hit—finding a spot, checking schedules, debating options. Twenty minutes later, you ordered takeout and called it a night. That was the old way.

Here's the new math: One tap on a mood in Tonight's Date. That's it. Cozy, adventurous, playful, healing—choose the feeling, not the logistics. The AI picks a card, plans the night, and sends it to your partner before you finish your coffee. Two minutes total, and you get a full-screen 'thought of you tonight' moment back. No planning, no friction, just the spark.

Couples who use Tonight's Date in their first 24 hours plan 4x more dates over the next month. Not because they have more time—because they stopped wasting twenty minutes on what should take two. The app handles the 'where' and 'when.' You handle the 'who.'

Open SoulPlan right now. Tap the home screen mood. See how fast a night can come together. P.S. That streak counter? Even if you pause a week, the no-shame freeze keeps your momentum alive—so you never feel behind on romance.
